LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaSpikeStaff.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid short spear
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaSpikeStaff.description: A handmade short spear with a metal head lashed to a wooden shaft and coated in purple aphrodisiac nanofluid. Shallow thrusts are intended to carry the fluid into the target through wounds. Direct contact delivers more fluid, but the sharp spearhead still inflicts real injuries and can kill.
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaBlowpipe.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid blowpipe
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaBlowpipe.description: A handmade blowpipe using light darts soaked in purple aphrodisiac nanofluid. The fluid enters through the wound. Its light darts inflict less trauma but struggle against armor. It allows frequent attempts at close to medium range, with accuracy falling sharply at greater distances.
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaLightCrossbow.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid light crossbow
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaLightCrossbow.description: A handmade light crossbow using bolts coated in purple aphrodisiac nanofluid to deliver fluid through wounds at greater range. It is more accurate than a blowpipe and can penetrate some light armor, but takes longer to load and aim, and inflicts more trauma.
